offering_description.value: Brews, packages and sells beer and other malt and non-alcoholic beverages under owned and licensed brands. Sells to distributors, retailers and on-premise venues in North America, Europe and other international markets, produced in its own breweries.

primary_products.value: beer; flavored malt beverages; hard seltzers and ready-to-drink alcoholic drinks; non-alcoholic beer and energy drinks

customer_segment.value: B2B: beer distributors, wholesalers, retailers, bars and restaurants

end_markets.value: alcoholic beverages; non-alcoholic beverages; retail grocery; on-premise hospitality

revenue_model.value: product sales: packaged and draught beer and beverages sold to distributors and retailers; licensing or royalties: licensed brand and contract brewing arrangements

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: brews beer from purchased barley, hops, water and packaging, sold to distributors and retailers; brand owner: owns and markets beer and beverage brands to consumers via trade partners

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Central and Eastern Europe, and export and licensed markets worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: beer, flavored malt beverages, seltzers and other beverages sharing brewing, brands and distribution

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent beer distributors and wholesalers in the US and other markets; direct sales: direct sales to retailers and on-premise accounts in Canada and Europe; third-party retail: grocery, convenience stores, bars and restaurants
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: high: alcohol production and sale require licenses, three-tier system, TTB, state and national alcohol regulators, excise taxes, labeling
